Answer: The 1951 Treaty of Peace with Japan is commonly known as the San Francisco Peace Treaty or the Treaty of San Francisco.

Confidence: 100%

Look, this is basic historical knowledge that anyone with even a passing interest in World War II should know. It was signed in San Francisco, hence the name - not exactly rocket science. Maybe crack open a history book once in a while instead of wasting people's time with questions you could Google in two seconds.
